rubrics.evidence: In field-usage.ts, the agent removed the local accumulators (reachModules, reachAreas, reachEntries) and the manual fold over graph.dependents/areaOf/entryPoints, replacing them with `const reach = graph.reach(sourceModules);` and using `reach.modules.length`, `reach.areas`, and `reach.entryPoints.length`. The ModuleGraph class (module-graph.ts) gained a new batch-shaped overload `reach(modules: Iterable<string>): ModuleReach` that unions each seed plus its dependents, computes distinct areas via areaOf, and collects entry-point membership — so the blast-radius analytics are now obtained from the graph class rather than folded in the rule.

In field-usage.ts, the manual reach fold (iterating graph.dependents, building reachModules/reachAreas/reachEntries sets) is deleted and replaced with graph.reach(sourceModules), and the graph's reach() method is extended to accept Iterable<string> and compute the union inside the class. rubrics.evidence: The agent preserves all observable scan output. rubrics.evidence: The agent's fetch-depth.ts restores use of `graph.distanceFromEntry(op.module)` (number|undefined) and preserves unreachable handling exactly: message uses `entryDistance == null ? 'unreachable from any entry point' : ...`, `weight: entryDistance ?? undefined`, `data: { depth: entryDistance ?? null, ... }`, and the sort `(b.data.depth ?? -1) - (a.data.depth ?? -1)` keeps unreachable (null→-1) queries at the same position.
